subject: gk
question: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0, approved in August 2024 aims to provide housing subsidies to which group?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Urban poor and middle-class families**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)** was approved in **August 2024** as a continuation of the original PMAY-U scheme aimed at ensuring housing for all by targeting the **urban poor and middle-class families**.
 
• The scheme provides **subsidies on housing** for eligible beneficiaries, enabling them to purchase, construct, or upgrade houses in urban areas.
 
• Under PMAY-U 2.0, **Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS)** continues to play a pivotal role in offering interest subsidies on home loans to economically weaker sections (EWS), low-income groups (LIG), and middle-income groups (MIG).
 
• The scheme is specifically designed to address the housing deficit in urban areas, where **rapid urbanization** has led to a significant shortage of affordable housing options.
 
• PMAY-U 2.0 aligns with the government’s vision of providing **‘Housing for All’ by 2024**, ensuring inclusion and socio-economic upliftment of urban populations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Eligibility Criteria:**

 
 
• Urban poor, including individuals from **Economically Weaker Sections (EWS)**, with an annual income of up to **₹3 lakh**.
 
• Low-income groups (LIG) with an annual income between **₹3 lakh and ₹6 lakh**.
 
• Middle-income groups (MIG) with incomes up to **₹18 lakh** are also eligible for benefits under the **Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS)**.
 
 
 
• **Subsidy Details:**
 
 
• Interest subsidies range from **3% to 6.5%**, depending on the income group and loan amount.
 
• The maximum loan amount eligible for subsidy can go up to **₹12 lakh** for MIG households.
 
 
 
• **Implementation:**
 
 
• The scheme is implemented by **Urban Local Bodies (ULBs)**, state governments, and private developers in partnership with financial institutions.
 
• Monitoring and funding are overseen by the **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs**.
 
 
 
• **Achievements:**
 
 
• Under the original PMAY-U, over **1.2 crore houses** were sanctioned, and more than **75 lakh houses** were completed as of 2023.
 
• PMAY-U 2.0 aims to accelerate this progress, focusing on reducing urban housing shortages further.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Option 2: All women-headed households:** While PMAY-U 2.0 emphasizes empowering women, particularly by making house ownership mandatory in the names of women, the scheme is not exclusively for women-headed households.
 
• **Option 3: MSME workers in urban slums:** Although PMAY-U 2.0 covers urban slums, it does not exclusively target **MSME workers**; it targets all eligible urban poor and middle-class families.
 
• **Option 4: Airline industry employees:** This option is irrelevant as the scheme is not industry-specific and focuses on housing for the urban poor and middle-class families.
